To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
students' perception of the online teaching process is negative.
the online learning experience is perceived by students as a negative one, and that the pandemic context has increased the negative aspects of online learning.
students are not ready for the online learning environment and that they do not consider that the advantages of this environment outweigh the disadvantages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the problems that students face in online learning and how universities can solve them.
how students perceive online teaching and learning in the current context of the pandemic.

how students' perceptions of online learning are influenced by the COVID 19 pandemic, the way in which they perceive online teaching and learning, and how their perceptions change during the pandemic.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
online teaching and learning in Romania during the pandemic is not a good solution, and that it is a solution that should be avoided.
, although online teaching and learning has been a reality for a long time, it was not prepared to face the challenges posed by the Coronavirus pandemic.
the online teaching and learning in the higher education during the coronavirus pandemic is a challenge for both students and teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the online learning environment has not been a success in Romania, and the pandemic has only highlighted the shortcomings of this educational method.
the online teaching and learning during the Coronavirus pandemic is not a good solution for students, but it is a necessity imposed by the current situation.
the online learning process in higher education during the Coronavirus pandemic is a process that is still not fully developed and requires further improvement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transition from traditional to online learning is not easy and requires time and resources.
universities must be prepared to face the challenges of exclusively online learning, and they need to be able to adapt to the new context.
the transition to online teaching and learning is possible but it requires a lot of time and effort from all stakeholders involved.
